answer_1.quote: We assess QSPEC with two primary criteria: (1) generation fidelity and (2) end-to-end serving speedup. For fidelity evaluation, we adopt not only traditional tasks, including PIQA (500, 10-shot), WinoGrande (500, 5-shot), and WikiText2, but also challenging multi-step reasoning tasks such as GSM8K (All, 8-shot), MATH (All, 4-shot), MBPP (200, 0-shot), and HumanEval (All, 0-shot).
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include natural language responses, mathematical reasoning steps, and code solutions.
